summary.one_liner: Snort 3 (Snort++), the next-generation Snort network intrusion detection and prevention system, built from source with CMake.
summary.what_it_does: Snort++ is the Snort 3.0.0 IPS/IDS engine, which the README says includes Snort 2.X features and bug fixes. It processes packets from pcap files or live traffic and can run in IDS mode with rules, using a Lua-based configuration file (snort.lua). It supports multiple packet processing threads, pluggable components, and sticky buffers in rules. The tool can dump and examine pcaps, verify configs with or without rules, and suppress specific rules by gid/sid from the command line. The README also covers libFuzzer fuzz targets built with Clang, with AddressSanitizer or coverage instrumentation, and documentation generated from the code.
use_cases: Network intrusion detection on captured traffic
Testing and validating Snort rules and configs
notable: snort2lua tool to convert Snort 2.X configs and rules
Libfuzzer fuzz targets with ASan or coverage builds
caveats: README lists Windows support and proxy mode as roadmap items, not current features
Requires a C++17 compiler (g++ 7 or newer) and many dependencies
The README describes the release as 3.0.0 (Build 250) and points to a tarball named a3, so it may be a pre-release snapshot
